title: NBA: Murray, Jokic rescue Nuggets in thriller, Heat down Thunder
summary: Jamal Murray scored 45 points and Nikola Jokic weighed in with a 37-point triple double as the Denver Nuggets battled to a 151-145 overtime victory over the Chicago Bulls in the NBA on Sunday.
